description: Integration foundation inside the EXISTING components, strictly additive and non-regressive. Extract CastResultDisplay's inline control clusters into shared presentational components used by both CastResultDisplay and (later) the guide, so there is no handler drift (design-loop MEDIUM-1). Widen the CastResultDisplay overcast render guard and add the optional onOvercastResolved capture callback. Add the optional guide seam to SpellCastingPanel (imperative handle, onCastResolved at all three setCastingResult sites, onOvercastResolved) WITHOUT yet rendering the overlay — the overlay wiring, guideActive suppression, and RollDialog-yield live in FEAT-003 where the overlay exists. Depends on FEAT-001 (CastingResult-derived helpers already present). The guide-off default path must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
steps: Create src/components/shared/castControls/CriticalChoiceButtons.tsx — a presentational component rendering the three Critical-Cast choice buttons (Critical Wound / Total Power / Unstoppable Force), taking `onCriticalChoice: (c: 'critical_wound'|'total_power'|'unstoppable_force') => void`. Move the matching markup out of CastResultDisplay verbatim.

Create src/components/shared/castControls/MiscastRollButtons.tsx — presentational component for the fumble 'Roll Minor Miscast' button and the minor-miscast-triggered 'Roll Minor Miscast' button, taking `onMiscastRoll: (t: 'minor'|'major') => void` and the flags it needs (isFumbledCast, triggerMinorMiscast). Move the matching markup out of CastResultDisplay.

Create src/components/shared/castControls/MiscastEscalation.tsx — presentational component for the miscast-result cluster: the cascading_chaos / multiplying_misfortune / marked_by_magic follow-ups INCLUDING the local arcaneMarkResult useState and the 'Store Mark on Character' control. Takes `miscastResult`, `character`, `onMiscastRoll`, `onArcaneMarkAcquired`. Move the matching markup + the d10 Math.random() arcane-mark roll out of CastResultDisplay unchanged (same getCharacterLore/getArcaneMarksTable wiring).

Refactor src/components/shared/CastResultDisplay.tsx to render the three extracted components in place of its inline clusters, wiring the SAME props/handlers it uses today. Keep rendered output and behaviour identical (non-behavioural refactor). Reuse or move the relevant CSS-module classes so styling is unchanged.

In CastResultDisplay.tsx add optional prop `onOvercastResolved?: (allocations: Record<string, number>) => void`; widen the overcast-section guard from `overcastSlots > 0 && castSuccess && onOvercastAllocated` to `overcastSlots > 0 && castSuccess && (onOvercastAllocated || onOvercastResolved)`; route `OvercastAllocator.onAllocate` to `onOvercastResolved ?? onOvercastAllocated`. Absence of both props still does not render the section; only onOvercastAllocated still closes-on-confirm as today.

In src/components/shared/SpellCastingPanel.tsx export `interface SpellCastingGuideHandle { openCast(spell): void; openChannel(spell): void; chooseCritical(choice): void; rollMiscast(table): void; dismissResult(): void }` (NO read-back method). Add optional props `guideHandleRef?: React.Ref<SpellCastingGuideHandle>`, `onCastResolved?: (result: CastingResult) => void`, `onOvercastResolved?: (allocations: Record<string, number>) => void`.

Wire useImperativeHandle(guideHandleRef, () => ({...})) delegating each method to the existing private functions openCastDialog / openChannelDialog / handleCriticalChoice / handleMiscastRoll / handleCloseCastResult.

Fire onCastResolved(result) at ALL THREE non-null setCastingResult(...) sites: handleRollResult initial resolve, handleCriticalChoice 'total_power' re-resolve, handleCriticalChoice 'unstoppable_force' re-resolve. Do NOT fire it in the display-only 'critical_wound' branch.

When onOvercastResolved is present, make handleOvercastAllocated forward the allocations to onOvercastResolved and NOT call setCastingResult(null) (keep the result alive); when it is absent, handleOvercastAllocated behaves exactly as today. Pass onOvercastResolved through to the CastResultDisplay the panel already renders.

Add src/components/shared/__tests__/castControls.nodrift.test.tsx (design-loop MEDIUM-1, MANDATORY): assert the extracted controls invoke the SAME handlers whether rendered inside CastResultDisplay or standalone — clicking the extracted Critical choice button calls onCriticalChoice; the escalation buttons call onMiscastRoll / onArcaneMarkAcquired — proving a single wiring with no drift between host surfaces.
Fix any error surfaced by the gate (per fix-errors steering), then re-run it.
acceptance_criteria: CastResultDisplay renders the extracted CriticalChoiceButtons / MiscastRollButtons / MiscastEscalation and its existing tests (CastResultDisplay.damage + spell-casting UI suites) pass UNCHANGED.

With no onOvercastResolved, the overcast section renders only when onOvercastAllocated is supplied (today's behaviour); with only onOvercastResolved supplied the section renders and routes onAllocate to the capture callback.

SpellCastingPanel compiles with the optional guideHandleRef/onCastResolved/onOvercastResolved props; when none are passed the panel renders and behaves exactly as today (existing SpellCastingPanel.* suites pass unchanged).

onCastResolved fires at the three setCastingResult sites and NOT in the critical_wound branch (assert via the no-drift / seam tests or FEAT-003 integration — at minimum the three-site wiring compiles and existing tests stay green).
The mandatory no-drift test passes, asserting the extracted controls reach the same handlers from both hosts.
Running `npx vitest --run` shows all existing suites green unchanged plus the new no-drift test passing.
verification: npx vitest --run src/components/shared/__tests__  (CastResultDisplay + spell-casting UI suites unchanged; castControls.nodrift passes)
npx eslint .  (0 errors; no new warnings beyond the 3 pre-existing)
findings:
Done & committed on the current branch. Full gate clean: tsc --build --force --noEmit exit 0; npm run build succeeds; npx vitest --run 5480/5480 pass across 507 files (existing suites UNCHANGED, +10 new tests in castControls.nodrift.test.tsx); npx eslint . 0 errors + only the 3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings (CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx) — no new warnings, NO eslint-disable added.

What landed (strictly additive, guide-off path byte-for-byte unchanged):
- NEW src/components/shared/castControls/CriticalChoiceButtons.tsx — the three Critical-Cast choice buttons; prop onCriticalChoice(c). Cites WoM Critical Casting (p.23). Markup moved verbatim.
- NEW src/components/shared/castControls/MiscastRollButtons.tsx — fumble + critical-triggered Minor Miscast sections (separators/labels kept); props isFumbledCast, triggerMinorMiscast, onMiscastRoll. Cites Core p.234-235 / WoM Fumbled Casting / WoM Critical Casting.
- NEW src/components/shared/castControls/MiscastEscalation.tsx — miscast-result cluster incl. the LOCAL arcaneMarkResult useState, cascading_chaos/multiplying_misfortune/marked_by_magic follow-ups, and the d10 Math.random() arcane-mark roll (getCharacterLore/getArcaneMarksTable wiring intact); props miscastResult, character, onMiscastRoll, onArcaneMarkAcquired. Cites Core p.234-235. All three import ../CastResultDisplay.module.css so styling is unchanged.
- CastResultDisplay.tsx refactored to render the three extracted components in place of its inline clusters with the SAME props/handlers (non-behavioural). Dropped now-unused imports (useState, getCharacterLore, getArcaneMarksTable, ArcaneMarkEntry). Added optional onOvercastResolved?(allocations); widened the overcast guard to `overcastSlots>0 && castSuccess && (onOvercastAllocated || onOvercastResolved)`; OvercastAllocator.onAllocate routes to `onOvercastResolved ?? onOvercastAllocated` (only onOvercastAllocated still closes-on-confirm; with neither prop the section still does not render).
- SpellCastingPanel.tsx: exported interface SpellCastingGuideHandle { openCast(spell); openChannel(spell); chooseCritical(choice); rollMiscast(table); dismissResult() } (NO read-back). Added optional props guideHandleRef?: Ref<SpellCastingGuideHandle>, onCastResolved?(result), onOvercastResolved?(allocations). useImperativeHandle delegates each method to the existing private handlers (openCastDialog/openChannelDialog/handleCriticalChoice/handleMiscastRoll/handleCloseCastResult). onCastResolved fires at ALL THREE non-null setCastingResult sites (handleRollResult initial resolve, total_power re-resolve, unstoppable_force re-resolve) and NOT in the critical_wound branch. handleOvercastAllocated now takes the allocations arg: when onOvercastResolved is present it forwards and keeps the result alive (no setCastingResult(null)); when absent it behaves exactly as today. onOvercastResolved is passed through to the CastResultDisplay the panel renders. The overlay/guideActive-suppression/RollDialog-yield are intentionally NOT added here (FEAT-003).
- NEW src/components/shared/__tests__/castControls.nodrift.test.tsx (design-loop MEDIUM-1, MANDATORY): asserts CriticalChoiceButtons/MiscastRollButtons/MiscastEscalation reach the SAME handlers standalone and inside CastResultDisplay (onCriticalChoice, onMiscastRoll minor/major, onArcaneMarkAcquired), plus the onOvercastResolved capture seam (renders with only onOvercastResolved, routes onAllocate to it, does NOT render with neither callback, and prefers onOvercastResolved when both are supplied).

Notes for FEAT-003: SpellCastingGuideHandle methods only enqueue state via setState (no synchronous read-back); push results via onCastResolved/onOvercastResolved. useImperativeHandle uses NO deps array (re-runs each render) so the handle always reflects the latest castingResult/rollDialogState — intentional to avoid a stale-closure read-back and to avoid an eslint-disable. The early-return no-talent gate was relocated BELOW all hooks (so hook order is stable and the react-hooks access-before-declare lint passes); the rendered no-talent Card output is identical. CombatPage still renders <SpellCastingPanel .../> with no new props, so the guide-off path is byte-for-byte unchanged.
